reason: Refactors ElasticsearchSearchContext to use SearchRequest directly and changes custom-query fallback/error-handling behavior in ElasticsearchService, which could alter search results or break existing custom Elasticsearch queries relying on the old query/highlight extraction logic, though it's scoped to the Elasticsearch module and includes new validation.
